verdict.rationale: Floot documents one-way code and database export ("export the code and the database and deploy them wherever you like") and an MCP server you can add to Cursor, VS Code, or Zed. Neither is documented as a round trip: there is no Git sync, repo pull/push, or way to bring locally edited code back into a Floot project. The MCP integration lets an AI assistant drive the hosted platform from your editor, which is an adjacent capability, not local development with your own tooling.

support.subject: As a developer, I can work on the app locally with my own editor and tooling and push changes back to the platform
